$comment: Pinned reference emulator of the benchmark: official Antmicro Renode v1.17.0 portable Linux build, run as an external process in the container image built from renode/Dockerfile (base image, Debian snapshot, and release archive SHA-256 pinned there). Nothing of it is linked into, vendored by or redistributed with this repository. License: BSD-3-Clause (Renode), used as a test oracle only. tools/run_renode.py and tools/run.py refuse an image whose /opt/renode/renode binary differs from binarySha256.
